Young adults show high rates of cashless cardiac procedures in Punjab

A significant number of young adults, aged 17-35, are undergoing cashless cardiac procedures under a Punjab health scheme. Data indicates 73 patients in this age group received treatment, highlighting a notable trend in cardiac health among younger Punjabis. This situation raises concerns about increasing cardiac risks in this demographic.
